# `⍴` — Shape / Reshape

`⍴Y` gives axis lengths.

```apl
⍴2 3⍴0             ⍝ 2ₓ 3ₓ
```

The shape is keyed by the axis names. An unnamed axis gives an unkeyed entry. See [named axes](../keyed.qmd#named-axes).

```apl
M←["city":2 "month":3]⍴⍳6
⍴M                 ⍝ ["city":2ₓ "month":3ₓ]
⍴M "month"         ⍝ 3ₓ
```

`S⍴Y` reshapes, cycling or truncating the ravel of `Y`. Dimensions are nonnegative integers. Empty `Y` supplies fill.

```apl
2 3⍴1 2            ⍝ 2 3⍴1 2 1 2 1 2
3⍴""               ⍝ "   "
```

An empty shape makes a rank-zero array.

```apl
⍬⍴1 2              ⍝ ⊂1
```

A keyed `S` names the axes of the result. An unkeyed `S` gives no names. When `S` matches the shape of `Y`, the result keeps the position keys of `Y`.

```apl
⍴["city":2 3]⍴⍳6   ⍝ ["city":2ₓ 3ₓ]
```
